headline: Government of India exercises over-subscription option in Cochin Shipyard Limited OFS
sum: **The President of India, via the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, announced its intention to invoke the over-subscription option in an ongoing offer-for-sale (OFS) of Cochin Shipyard Limited, covering 66,29,636 equity shares.** The move signals continued government disinvestment of its stake in the shipbuilding public sector enterprise.
detail: Cochin Shipyard Limited is a Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways CPSE engaged in shipbuilding and ship repair. The government entity announced its option to over-subscribe in the ongoing OFS, indicating additional shares (up to the 66,29,636 limit stated) may be offered to retail and institutional bidders. The notification came via NSE corporate announcement channel on 7 July 2026. No transaction value, pricing or final allotment quantum was disclosed in this announcement.
